issuer: the Rhode Island Division of Motor Vehicles
note: The Rhode Island General Laws on rilegislature.gov (read 2026-10-30): § 31-10-31 charges $25 for an operator's first licence ($30 to renew, $5 for the first examination, not held); § 31-10-30 makes the first licence a temporary one to the birthday in the second year and every licence after it expire on the birthday in the fifth year, so the regular term, 5 years, is held; § 31-10-6 issues a full operator's licence from 17 after twelve months on a limited provisional one. § 3-8-6 has the division issue a Rhode Island identification card to anyone 21 or older for $25, renewed every five years (free from 59); no card for someone younger was found there, so the card is held from 21.

sources.title: R.I. Gen. Laws § 31-10-31, Fees
sources.said: (1) For every operator’s first license to operate a motor vehicle, twenty-five dollars ($25.00);

sources.title: R.I. Gen. Laws § 31-10-30, Expiration and renewal of licenses
sources.said: Every operator’s and chauffeur’s license issued after expiration of the temporary license shall expire on the birthday of the licensee in the fifth year following the issuance of the license

sources.title: R.I. Gen. Laws § 31-10-6, Graduated licensing
sources.said: A person who is at least seventeen (17) years old but less than eighteen (18) years old may apply for and obtain a full operator’s license

sources.title: R.I. Gen. Laws § 3-8-6, Rhode Island identification cards
sources.said: shall issue to any person who has reached his or her twenty-first (21st) birthday a Rhode Island identification card upon payment of a fee of twenty-five dollars ($25) ... (3) Each registration card shall be subject to renewal every five (5) years upon payment of a fee of twenty-five dollars ($25).
